pages.text: Your fleet can look spectacular! Each Zephyr Hauler uses $(2)Colored Wool$() for its balloon fabric, allowing you to color-code your logistics network by destination or product type.
The standard White Hauler. A blank canvas for your network.
Red Hauler: Often used for heavy ore or construction materials.
Blue Hauler: Ideal for fluids and precious bottled resources.
Green Hauler: Perfectly suited for agricultural goods and food.
Yellow Hauler: Great for high-visibility logistics or light items.

pages.title: Re-dyeing
pages.text: If you already have a hauler but want to change its color, you can re-dye it by placing it in a $(2)Crafting Table$() with the desired dye. This keeps all your current upgrades and link data intact!
